author: juju9708

title: Best routine app ever
body: This is the most useful app I’ve ever installed. 90 day streak! I don’t have ADHD, but I do have long COVID and energy conservation is key for me. Before using this app, I would spend a lot of energy in the morning mentally creating a list of all the things I needed to do next. “Ok, right now I’ll make coffee, then I’ll get ready to walk the dog, then I’ll make breakfast…” Now I can mindfully go about my morning because I don’t need to worry if I’ll forget something important, or if I’ll be late for work - it’s easy to see when I’ll be finished the routine! I also don’t get distracted halfway through my routine and start online shopping or messaging a friend. This app has done so much for my recovery, and is my favourite productivity app by far. I’m also very appreciative of how many performance improvements the dev has made in the past 3 months. Looking forward to seeing whatever’s next!

title: Needs a little something…
body: I’m just getting started with the app, a couple of things to consider:  It really needs a customizable widget.  Maybe have an option to set up blocks of time (ex:a 2 hour window with no specific start or end time) that you can add all the tasks you want to get done in that time block. Regimented time constraints often works against ADHDers.  Also adding a big task (ex: Declutter Closet) and being able to customize it with the small steps to complete it would be great.  Otherwise it’s a good app for people like me.

author: HaiderDaGOAT

title: FORGET ANY OTHER APP
body:
Other apps have too much going on and are way too distracting for ADHD me. 
THIS APP THOUGH, the routine is TIMED, isn’t tied to a specific hour (even been like, “oh no, it’s 8:01 so I’ll just have to wait ‘til 8:30!”?)- but has set reminders, recommends a TRIGGER to start the routine, and is overall simply and EASY.

Listen, I’ve tried EVERY SINGLE ROUTINE/SCHEDULE/HABIT app/planner/calendar out there. Seriously. It burns out after a while THIS ONE WORKS FOR ME.

My ONLY suggestion is if there was a widget option- shows me when my routine’s coming up, and an immediate button for me to start the timed routine from the widget. When it’s not in my face, I can forget or accidentally swipe my notifs.

It’s only $26 bucks. I paid for $5 to try for the month and it’s already a godsend. This plus a goal streaks app together, boom.

*mic drop*

title: Easy to use + effective
body: Love the clean and simple UI. The app is really intuitive to use and great for those who just want to focus on getting their routines completed. Suggestions for improvement would be being able to duplicate routines, a broader calendar view, and ability to enable/disable routines (e.g. if I’m on vacation). Would also love to have it available as a widget on my Home Screen (so I can see my upcoming routines or a summary without having to open the app).
